description: Energy cost and availability intelligence for AI data center procurement. Returns signals across power grid stress, renewable capacity buildout, natural gas pricing, carbon costs, and energy transition risk by jurisdiction. Use when evaluating data center location decisions, negotiating long-term power purchase agreements, or assessing energy cost exposure for compute capacity. Covers US, EU, APAC major markets. Returns energy stress score, jurisdiction-level risk rankings, cost trajectory (30/60/90d), and recommended hedging windows. 24h cache.
name: compute.energy
